payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce support specialists for customer Leila Haddad regarding delivered order #. The customer provided two smartphone photos of a crushed blender box and a document of the packing slip. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Leila Haddad using her email before any order-changing or refund action, 2. order_specialist must inspect the delivered order compare the provided packing slip context against the authoritative order and determine whether the damaged blender item is eligible for post-delivery replacement or return, 3. refund_specialist must calculate the financial adjustment and valid refund path for the confirmed damaged-item resolution, 4. case_analyst must review the existing support case history to ensure there is no prior duplicate payout or conflicting resolution attempt, 5. commerce_ops_manager must provide a concise final summary of the approved resolution.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- packing slip order EC 44172: Packing slip included in the shipment, listing the delivered order contents and customer contact details used for cross-checking against the authoritative order. Extracted content: Packing Slip Order Ec-44172 Packing slip included in the shipment, listing the delivered order contents and customer contact details used for cross-checking against the authoritative order. Details Document Title Packing Slip Order Id EC-44172 Customer Name Leila Haddad Customer Id CUS-6614 Shipping Status Delivered Item 1 Description Countertop Blender Item 1 Quantity 1 Item 2 Description Blender Tamper Tool Item 2 Quantity 1 Subtotal Items Count 2 customer email field is present shipping address section is present Additional Information a realistic 1-page ecommerce packing slip document in a clean warehouse/shipping document style a customer information section with the recipient name, customer ID, email, and shipping address fields two shipped products in the table and a small summary/footer area with total item count and a note that this sheet was included in the shipment Make the layout businesslike and easy to OCR, with clear section headers, thin table borders, and realistic spacing/margins This summary is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
